Name: Sir Robert's Plant Emporium
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial][b][u]Description[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Sir Robert's Plant Emporium is another chapter in my on-going series featuring houseplants and flowers in pretty pots or vases. They can be placed upon end tables or countertops. Mix them with flowers or plants from my other mods, such as Sir Robert's Tiny Plant Collection, for the ultimate flower power experience.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]This mod allows you to create a beautiful space in your Stardew Valley home with lush plants and floral arrangements. Add as many as you'd like! Go wild and crazy with decorating! You can never have enough flowers and plants in your Stardew Valley home.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. The folder will contain images for the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial][b][u]Main features[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Once downloaded, the images can be found in the Decor/Houseplant section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Image #1 through #9 consists of flowers/plants that will fit on [u]end tables[/u]. I've "recycled" plants from the actual game or flowers of my own design and placed them into a variety of different pots or vases via Alternative Textures.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Image #10 is for a group of flowers/plants from 1 through 9 that have been moved up the screen a few pixels and align with [u]countertops[/u].[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]Requires Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. Also, I recommend using Happy Home Designer and Precise Furniture.[/font][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=4][font=Arial][b][u]Shout outs[/u][/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#ffffff][size=3][font=Arial]The end tables shown in the pictures are from mods made by lululovely, PlatinumCats, Orangeblossom7, twinkle22, smallcopper, Creamy Cozy Decor by ENGloomy and from the Furniture Catalog in Stardew Valley. The countertops are from PC's Shabby Chic Kitchen by PlatinumCats. They also look beautiful with countertops from Lovely Kitchen Islands and Extras (AT) by lululovely.[/font][/size][/color]
